turns.q: If I cancel, how long until I'm refunded?
turns.replyTail:
CEL, HOW LONG UNTIL I'M REFUNDED?
For most orders, we can’t cancel once they’re placed, so there isn’t a cancellation refund timeline. If you return an eligible item instead, an approved refund is issued to your original payment method within 10 BUSINESS DAYS AFTER WE RECEIVE AND INSPECT THE RETURN; your bank may take additional time to post it. You can start a return through our RETURN PORTAL.
Orders shipped to the EU have a separate 14-day right to cancel or return.
